German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius said Europe should negotiate with Russian leader Vladimir Putin, but not in Moscow. He stressed that any such talks must include a ceasefire, arguing that Russia cannot continue launching attacks while claiming to seek negotiations. “If negotiations take place, one thing must be clear: a ceasefire must be part of them. You cannot continue launching strikes while simultaneously pretending that you want to negotiate. There is almost no sign of any genuine willingness on Putin’s part to negotiate,” Pistorius said. Putin previously invited European representatives to Moscow to discuss a possible end to Russia’s war against Ukraine. President Zelenskyy, meanwhile, has opposed European leaders traveling to Moscow for such talks.
